sourceNote: The 102-benchmark corpus remains checked through August 31, 2026. Taxonomy membership follows Supplementary Fig. S1; 401 target-task records and their fully classified joint Protocol-Metrics-Data coding follow Supplementary Tables S1-S7 and the final September 15, 2026 consistency checklist. Two auxiliary records are retained for traceability and excluded from target-task statistics.
yearBasis: Benchmark release year as coded in Figure 2 of the final September 15, 2026 manuscript; distinct from formal publication year.
codingScope: Each evaluationRecords item is one observed Protocol-Metrics-Data combination within a target or downstream role. Filters match all selected evidence dimensions within the same combination; selections within a filter group use OR and selections across groups use AND. Benchmark-level records contain unions for overview only.
